'''Health and environment'''
*[[2026 Central Africa Ebola epidemic|2026 Ebola epidemic]]
**The [[World Health Organization]] raises its assessment of the risk from the [[Ebola]] outbreak within the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] (DRC) from "high" to "very high" due to its rapid spread, while keeping it "low" at the global level. [[Director-General of the World Health Organization|Director-general]] [[Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus]] says that the outbreak in [[Uganda]] is stable. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/who-chief-says-ebola-situation-in-dr-congo-deeply-worrisome/3945711 (AA)] [https://apnews.com/article/congo-ebola-outbreak-who-4e08d8df6d9c34039a9e0b8bad7a8954 (AP)]
**The [[Ituri Province|Ituri]] provincial government orders funerals to be conducted only by specialized personnel, limits public gatherings to no more than fifty people, and suspends the local [[association football|football]] league. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/un-sends-emergency-funds-staff-tackle-congo-ebola-crisis-2026-05-22/ (Reuters)]
**[[Rwanda]] imposes a [[travel ban]] on foreign nationals that have been to the DRC in the past thirty days, and requires a [[quarantine]] for [[Rwandan nationality law|Rwandan citizens]] or residents who have been there. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/un-sends-emergency-funds-staff-tackle-congo-ebola-crisis-2026-05-22/ (Reuters)]
**[[United Nations]] [[Under-Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs and Emergency Relief Coordinator|emergency relief coordinator]] [[Tom Fletcher (diplomat)|Tom Fletcher]] announces that the organization is providing [[United States dollar|US$]]60 million in funding for the outbreak response. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/un-sends-emergency-funds-staff-tackle-congo-ebola-crisis-2026-05-22/ (Reuters)]
